evidence_passages.text:
Assuming “last Tuesday” means **August 25, 2026**, my best answer is:

**Supported fact:** I found **no good web evidence of a new public Project Xanadu event on that date**. The Project Xanadu pages I found are old or archival in character: the main homepage includes a `crudcheck 01.05.23` marker and a “WE FIGHT ON” message, not a dated August 2026 announcement. https://www.xanadu.com/xuhome.html

**Supported fact:** One of the main public FAQ pages for Xanadu says `Last-modified: 2002/04/12`. https://www.aus.xanadu.com/xanadu/faq.html

**Supported fact:** A Xanadu demo page says it was created for the **Future of Text Conference, August 25, 2016**, and says, “We do not have a product, but a preliminary capability.” https://xanadu.com/xuDemoPage.html

**Supported fact:** The clearly dated **August 25, 2026** “Xanadu” news I did find was about **Xanadu Quantum Technologies** and Mitsubishi Chemical expanding a quantum-semiconductor collaboration, not about **Project Xanadu**. https://investors.xanadu.ai/news-releases/news-release-details/canada-japan-funding-fuels-xanadu-and-mitsubishi-chemical  
https://thequantuminsider.com/2026/08/25/xanadu-mitsubishi-quantum-semiconductor-manufacturing/

**Inference:** So the most defensible conclusion is that **nothing well-documented and publicly notable seems to have happened to Project Xanadu itself last Tuesday**, at least in material discoverable via the web pages above. https://www.xanadu.com/xuhome.html  
https://www.aus.xanadu.com/xanadu/faq.html  
https://xanadu.com/xuDemoPage.html

**Why it happened (inference):** The likeliest explanation is **not that a documented event happened for a known reason, but that there is no solid evidence of any public event to explain**. The Project Xanadu web presence I found looks largely historical rather than actively updated with current news. https://www.xanadu.com/xuhome.html  
https://www.aus.xanadu.com/xanadu/faq.html  
https://xanadu.com/xuDemoPage.html

**Uncertainty:** That does **not** prove nothing happened privately, off-web, or on an unindexed channel; it only means I did not find reliable public evidence for a Tuesday event using web-searchable sources.

**Disagreement:** I did not find a substantive source disagreeing about a specific August 25, 2026 Project Xanadu event. The main ambiguity was between **Project Xanadu** and the unrelated company **Xanadu Quantum Technologies**. https://investors.xanadu.ai/news-releases/news-release-details/canada-japan-funding-fuels-xanadu-and-mitsubishi-chemical  
https://thequantuminsider.com/2026/08/25/xanadu-mitsubishi-quantum-semiconductor-manufacturing/

**Bottom line:** On the available web evidence, **probably nothing publicly documented happened to Project Xanadu last Tuesday**, and there is therefore **no well-supported “why”** beyond the lack of evidence itself.
